structured_output.what_is_happening: A 10-day-old pump.fun token, MRBEAST (already migrated to PumpSwap), has suddenly revived. Its price is up about 750-1250% in the past hour and about 2100-3000% in 6 hours. It went from near-dead to about $95-105k market cap on $93-105k of hourly volume, with roughly 388 unique buyers against 219 sellers. Almost all of its lifetime volume came in the last hour, so something set off a sharp re-discovery. The description, "Fees to @mrbeast", means pump.fun creator fees are routed to MrBeast's X handle. It is a celebrity-name fee-share meme from a serial launcher (518 tokens launched; the creator has closed out). At detection, DexScreener showed the 5-minute price down about 21%, a pullback from an ATH near $165k market cap.

narrative.description: A MrBeast celebrity-name meme where creator fees go to @mrbeast. These can spike if the celebrity claims the fees, acknowledges the token, or if fee-share tokens become a trend. Otherwise it is a generic celebrity-name coin.
narrative.why_spreading: A dormant 10-day-old coin jumping about 20x in an hour, with hundreds of new unique buyers, suggests a catalyst. That could be a fee claim, a post, or a call-channel or KOL push; 4 renowned and 45 smart wallets are present. The packet cannot show which.

token_connection.why_this_token: This is the only MrBeast-named token with real liquidity and live volume right now. It is linked to the @MrBeast handle through fee routing, and it is among the older MrBeast pump.fun launches in this batch.
token_connection.competing_tokens: Many MrBeast clones exist: FmiF and GKBT show inflated market caps but no liquidity, and several newer pump.fun MrBeast coins have tiny liquidity. None of them has live volume.

authenticity.evidence: Breadth looks genuine: 388 unique buyers in the hour, about 1,217 holders, and top-10 holders at about 31% spread evenly at around 3% each. Against that, GMGN tags 325 bundler wallets, puts the bot/degen rate at 0.79, and counts 438 fresh wallets, with bundlers holding about 29% of top-trader share. There is also a 5-wallet transfer insider network. The dev is a serial launcher (518 tokens) and has already closed out. No paid DexScreener promotion is flagged.
authenticity.uncertainty: There is no X data, so I cannot tell whether MrBeast actually engaged or whether a call channel is driving this. The very even ~3% top-holder spread could come from a bundled accumulation.

structural_risks: Serial dev (518 launches) whose creator position is closed
High bundler and bot share; top holders at a uniform ~3% may be coordinated
A price that went up ~20x in an hour is prone to sharp retraces; the 5-minute price was already down ~21%
Liquidity of about $29k against ~$100k market cap is thin, so the price moves hard in both directions
Many same-name clones compete for the same attention

structured_output.counterargument: This could just be a coordinated pump of a dead token by bundled wallets and a call group, with the celebrity name only as a hook. After a 20x move in an hour and a 20% drop within 5 minutes, the most likely path is a slow bleed of more than 50% as the early buyers take profit. Against that, the fee-to-MrBeast angle offers a real viral catalyst. If MrBeast (or a large account) acknowledges the fees, a MrBeast coin can easily reach $1M or more, and the target of about $200k is only slightly above the recent ATH.
unknowns: What caused the revival (a MrBeast fee claim or post, versus a call channel)
Whether the ~3% top holders are one bundled entity
How the price moves in the 4 minutes before entry, after the -21% candle
What the renowned and smart wallets are doing: accumulating or exiting

source_coverage.notes: No-internet condition; the judgment rests only on the packet.

structured_output.thesis: A strong revival with real breadth and a celebrity fee-share hook that could go viral. Structural rug risk is low (LP burned, authorities renounced). But the heavy bundler and bot share, a serial dev, and entry into a pullback after a 20x move make stopping out at -50% more likely than a clean 2x. The runner odds are above the base rate thanks to the momentum and the narrative, but this is not a high-conviction call.
